item.text:
Refactored the telemetry plumbing further by making `SearchTelemetryContext` the single construction point for search telemetry bundles.

What changed:
- Added factory methods to [SearchTelemetryContext.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/SearchTelemetryContext.java) so callers can build telemetry with `of(...)` or `from(...)` instead of repeating extraction-plus-wrapping logic.
- Removed the local `createTelemetryContext(...)` helpers from [TransportSearchAction.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/TransportSearchAction.java) and [TransportSearchShardsAction.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/TransportSearchShardsAction.java).
- Updated [SearchService.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/search/SearchService.java) and [ShardSearchPhaseAPMMetrics.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/search/stats/ShardSearchPhaseAPMMetrics.java) to use the new factories.
- Updated [CanMatchPreFilterSearchPhaseTests.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/test/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/CanMatchPreFilterSearchPhaseTests.java) to use the new `SearchTelemetryContext.of(...)` helper.
